deleteAccount.title: Ggyawo akawunti yo
deleteAccount.intro: Okuggyawo akawunti kya lubeerera. Ojja kufuluma buli wamu era tosobola kuyingira nayo nate.
deleteAccount.removed1: Erinnya lyo, email yo, essimu yo n'ekifaananyi kya puloofayiro
deleteAccount.removed2: Abaweereza b'otereka, enkolagana z'ozibudde n'ebyafaayo by'okunoonya
deleteAccount.removed3: Eri abaweereza: puloofayiro y'bizinensi yo, ebitundibwa n'ebifaananyi
deleteAccount.kept: Ebiwandiiko by'okusasula, ebiragiro n'amatikiti abantu abalala n'ebitabo byaffe bye beesigamako. Bisigalawo, naye nga tebiriiko linnya lyo wadde ebikukwatako.
deleteAccount.signInText: Olw'obukuumi bwo olina okusooka okuyingira. Oluvannyuma olupapula luno lukuganya okuggyawo akawunti yo mu ddakiika emu.
deleteAccount.doneText: Weebale okukozesa Gabla. Ofulumye era ebikukwatako biggyiddwawo.
deleteAccount.errFailed: Tetusobodde kuggyawo akawunti yo kati. Gezaako nate.
deleteAccount.errSupport: Akawunti ey'engeri eno eggyibwawo abakozi baffe. Tuukirira obuyambi okugiggyawo.
deleteAccount.errBlockedRide: Olina olugendo olugenda mu maaso. Sooka olumalirize oba olusazeemu.
deleteAccount.errBlockedTickets: Olina amatikiti g'ebbaasi ag'ennaku ezijja. Sooka ogasazeemu oba ogende.
deleteAccount.errBlockedOrders: Olina ebiragiro ebitannatuuka. Linda biggwe oba obisazeemu.
deleteAccount.errBlockedBookings: Olina bookinga z'obuweereza ezikyali nzigule. Zisazeemu oba olinde ziggwe.
deleteAccount.errBlockedBalance: Sooka ggyayo ssente ezisigaddewo mu wallet yo.
